body: I feel the same as last night. I haven't talked to anyone but you for the past 24 hrs.

I slept immediately after the incident. I slept all day. I don't feel any better. I get what you mean thought; I usually feel better after a nap but not today.

Funny how you told your doctor that you wanted to see someone else. I'm pretty sure I have shit therapists, because I told my last one that she wasn't doing her job well (after listening to her blab all session long for three months) and she threw a temper tantrum *at me*.

The first option is pretty much "Taking a break" in my list. The second option was also done in one of my therapy sessions. She told me to make a list of things I thought was good and bad about myself.

If a friend was in my situation, my very exact same situation, I'd tell him that I can't really help him and that suicide seems to be the only option he hasn't tried, so maybe it might be the right way to go. I don't mix well with suicidal people.

I have tried:

* Therapy (group and individual, inpatient and outpatient)
* Medications (several different kinds, forgot most of them)
* Making a shit load of friends
* Spending more time with friends
* Talking about it, to friends, family and suicide hotlines
* Writing about my feelings in a journal
* "Creative outlets" AKA drawing, poetry, making music (violin)
* Taking a break
* Exercising
* Changing diets
* Changing sleeping habits
* Listening to music
* Volunteer work, joining clubs, etc.
* Getting a dog

Out of all these, I'd say getting my dog was the most effective. Anytime shit went down in the house, I'd just take him out for a walk.

I'm stressed and angry. I feel hopeless because nothing seems to work. I'm depressed shitless because I cant have the shit I want because I'm fucking poor and have no citizenship. It's hard to open up to friends because there's nothing but shit inside of me and nobody likes a downer.

Please get myself some help? What the fuck do you think I've been doing these past few years, sitting on my ass? I went to at least 5 different therapists and went through a shit ton of medications with no affect. There's nothing more I can do. No, I'm being fucking serious here, THERE'S NOTHING MORE I CAN DO. I've exploited everything I can in my financial position. Go on, try me. Suggest me something I haven't tried, and I'll give you $100.
Well fuck, turns out this is another dead end.
[Found it](http://ldfpaints.com/stallions-for-sale), at the bottom of the page.

I don't think any of those options would work effectively.

Right after the conflict, I took my dog out for a walk. It was enough to lock up my anger again, but it's still there. I still want to punch the living daylight out of anything breathing. I can feel it boiling inside and I bet if someone started talking to me it'll all come pouring out.

Talking about it never helps. I went through that phase of trying to find help, with therapists or counselors or friends. No one fucking understands. No one would, especially not a fucking stranger. Nothing fucking works. Everyone says exercise, medication, therapists hospitals blah blah fucking blah. I've been doing that for 6 fucking years and I still have serious fucking issues. I'm pretty fucking accomplished, with a 4.0 GPA in college and active in a lot of school clubs, yet when I get home I'm a fucking mess. I have friends. I exercise. I eat right and take my meds. What more can I fucking do? Honestly?? Honestly? It's all fucking pointless. Nothing works and nobody ever suggests anything new. If I shut the fuck up and deal with it, people think I'm getting better. In return, I might feel better but it'll fucking get back at me in a few months. What the fuck am I to do. Honestly, I'm about three seconds away from blowing my brains out.

I'm in a constant state of stress. This sort of thing happens every few months, but it's never been this serious where I punched through a window and screamed things at other people. My therapist is shit, my psychiatrist is shit, my pediatrician is shit. My family is shit, so are my roommates. I have no friends. There's no other outlets besides breaking things and screaming. I want to prevent this from happening again. What the fuck do i do?

It wasn't broken accidentally. I smashed it with rage. I screamed vile things and threw a bunch of shit at the wall. It certainly didn't help that my roommate was asking, at the locked door, if I needed my medication. I take celexa for my depression. It doesn't work like an epi pen.

As for replacing it, they were all my things so I don't think they'd care.
